data.title: Make the data repo token
tips: The name can be anything. You can make several tokens for the same repo, for example one per phone or computer.
Exactly this: only your mygeeky-data repo, Contents: Read and write.

steps.title: Open GitHub's new token page
steps.text: Use the button: it opens GitHub's "New fine-grained token" page. Sign in to GitHub there if it asks.

steps.title: Name it anything
steps.text: For example "myGeeKy phone". The name is only a label for you.
steps.svg: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150' width='320' height='150'><rect x='0.5' y='0.5' width='319' height='149' rx='10' fill='#0d1117' stroke='#30363d' stroke-width='1'/><text x='16' y='26' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#e6edf3' font-weight='bold' text-anchor='start'>New fine-grained token</text><line x1='16' y1='36' x2='304' y2='36' stroke='#30363d'/><text x='16' y='58' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#e6edf3' font-weight='bold' text-anchor='start'>Token name *</text><rect x='16' y='66' width='220' height='26' rx='6' fill='#161b22' stroke='#30363d' stroke-width='1'/><text x='26' y='83' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#e6edf3' font-weight='normal' text-anchor='start'>myGeeKy phone</text><rect x='12' y='62' width='228' height='34' rx='9' fill='none' stroke='#ff6fd8' stroke-width='2.5'/><text x='16' y='112' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='10' fill='#8b949e' font-weight='normal' text-anchor='start'>Any name works: it is only a label for you</text></svg>

steps.text: A long one is easiest (90 days or a year); myGeeKy reminds you a week before it ends.

signals.title: Make the Signals token
tips: The name can be anything. You can make several tokens for the same repo, for example one per phone or computer.
Exactly this: only your mygeeky-beacon repo, Contents: Read and write.
Signals is optional: skip it and everything else still works.

read.title: Make a read-only token
tips: The name can be anything. You can make several tokens for the same repo, for example one per phone or computer.
Exactly this: Public repositories, and Account → Followers: Read-only. It can never follow anyone or write anything.
Easier: Sign in with GitHub instead, and you need no token at all.

steps.title: Open GitHub's new token page
steps.text: Use the button: it opens GitHub's "New fine-grained token" page. Sign in to GitHub there if it asks.
steps.svg: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150' width='320' height='150'><rect x='0.5' y='0.5' width='319' height='149' rx='10' fill='#0d1117' stroke='#30363d' stroke-width='1'/><rect x='12' y='14' width='296' height='26' rx='6' fill='#161b22' stroke='#30363d' stroke-width='1'/><text x='24' y='31' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='10' fill='#8b949e' font-weight='normal' text-anchor='start'>github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new</text><text x='16' y='66' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#e6edf3' font-weight='bold' text-anchor='start'>Fine-grained personal access tokens</text><rect x='16' y='82' width='150' height='28' rx='6' fill='#238636' stroke='#238636' stroke-width='1'/><text x='91' y='100' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#ffffff' font-weight='bold' text-anchor='middle'>Generate new token</text><rect x='12' y='78' width='158' height='36' rx='9' fill='none' stroke='#ff6fd8' stroke-width='2.5'/><text x='160.0' y='142' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='10' fill='#8b949e' font-weight='normal' text-anchor='middle'>The button in myGeeKy opens this page for you</text></svg>

steps.title: Name it anything
steps.text: For example "mygeeky". The name is only a label for you.
steps.svg: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150' width='320' height='150'><rect x='0.5' y='0.5' width='319' height='149' rx='10' fill='#0d1117' stroke='#30363d' stroke-width='1'/><text x='16' y='26' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#e6edf3' font-weight='bold' text-anchor='start'>New fine-grained token</text><line x1='16' y1='36' x2='304' y2='36' stroke='#30363d'/><text x='16' y='58' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#e6edf3' font-weight='bold' text-anchor='start'>Token name *</text><rect x='16' y='66' width='220' height='26' rx='6' fill='#161b22' stroke='#30363d' stroke-width='1'/><text x='26' y='83' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#e6edf3' font-weight='normal' text-anchor='start'>mygeeky</text><rect x='12' y='62' width='228' height='34' rx='9' fill='none' stroke='#ff6fd8' stroke-width='2.5'/><text x='16' y='112' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='10' fill='#8b949e' font-weight='normal' text-anchor='start'>Any name works: it is only a label for you</text></svg>

steps.title: Choose how long it lasts
steps.text: A long one is easiest (90 days or a year); myGeeKy reminds you a week before it ends.
steps.svg: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150' width='320' height='150'><rect x='0.5' y='0.5' width='319' height='149' rx='10' fill='#0d1117' stroke='#30363d' stroke-width='1'/><text x='16' y='26' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#e6edf3' font-weight='bold' text-anchor='start'>New fine-grained token</text><line x1='16' y1='36' x2='304' y2='36' stroke='#30363d'/><text x='16' y='58' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#e6edf3' font-weight='bold' text-anchor='start'>Expiration *</text><rect x='16' y='66' width='140' height='26' rx='6' fill='#161b22' stroke='#30363d' stroke-width='1'/><text x='26' y='83' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#e6edf3' font-weight='normal' text-anchor='start'>90 days</text><text x='144' y='83' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#8b949e' font-weight='normal' text-anchor='end'>▾</text><rect x='12' y='62' width='148' height='34' rx='9' fill='none' stroke='#ff6fd8' stroke-width='2.5'/><text x='16' y='112' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='10' fill='#8b949e' font-weight='normal' text-anchor='start'>Pick a long one: myGeeKy reminds you before it ends</text></svg>

steps.title: Repository access
steps.text: Choose "Public repositories".
steps.svg: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150' width='320' height='150'><rect x='0.5' y='0.5' width='319' height='149' rx='10' fill='#0d1117' stroke='#30363d' stroke-width='1'/><text x='16' y='26' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#e6edf3' font-weight='bold' text-anchor='start'>Repository access</text><line x1='16' y1='36' x2='304' y2='36' stroke='#30363d'/><circle cx='24' cy='54' r='6' fill='#0d1117' stroke='#e6edf3' stroke-width='1.5'/><circle cx='24' cy='54' r='3' fill='#e6edf3'/><rect x='10' y='39' width='178' height='28' rx='9' fill='none' stroke='#ff6fd8' stroke-width='2.5'/><text x='38' y='58' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#e6edf3' font-weight='normal' text-anchor='start'>Public repositories</text><circle cx='24' cy='78' r='6' fill='#0d1117' stroke='#8b949e' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='38' y='82' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#8b949e' font-weight='normal' text-anchor='start'>All repositories</text><circle cx='24' cy='102' r='6' fill='#0d1117' stroke='#8b949e' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='38' y='106' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#8b949e' font-weight='normal' text-anchor='start'>Only select repositories</text></svg>

steps.title: Followers: Read-only
steps.text: Under Account permissions, set Followers to "Read-only". Add nothing else.
steps.svg: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150' width='320' height='150'><rect x='0.5' y='0.5' width='319' height='149' rx='10' fill='#0d1117' stroke='#30363d' stroke-width='1'/><text x='16' y='26' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#e6edf3' font-weight='bold' text-anchor='start'>Permissions · Account</text><line x1='16' y1='36' x2='304' y2='36' stroke='#30363d'/><rect x='16' y='52' width='288' height='30' rx='6' fill='#161b22' stroke='#30363d' stroke-width='1'/><text x='26' y='71' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#e6edf3' font-weight='bold' text-anchor='start'>Followers</text><rect x='188' y='56' width='106' height='22' rx='6' fill='#161b22' stroke='#30363d' stroke-width='1'/><text x='196' y='71' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='10' fill='#e6edf3' font-weight='normal' text-anchor='start'>Read-only</text><text x='288' y='71' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='10' fill='#8b949e' font-weight='normal' text-anchor='end'>▾</text><rect x='184' y='52' width='114' height='30' rx='9' fill='none' stroke='#ff6fd8' stroke-width='2.5'/><text x='16' y='104' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='10' fill='#8b949e' font-weight='normal' text-anchor='start'>Add nothing else.</text></svg>

steps.title: Generate it, then copy it
steps.text: Click Generate token at the bottom of the page, then copy the token: GitHub shows it only once.
steps.svg: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150' width='320' height='150'><rect x='0.5' y='0.5' width='319' height='149' rx='10' fill='#0d1117' stroke='#30363d' stroke-width='1'/><text x='16' y='26' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#e6edf3' font-weight='bold' text-anchor='start'>Overview</text><line x1='16' y1='36' x2='304' y2='36' stroke='#30363d'/><rect x='16' y='50' width='130' height='28' rx='6' fill='#238636' stroke='#238636' stroke-width='1'/><text x='81' y='68' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#ffffff' font-weight='bold' text-anchor='middle'>Generate token</text><rect x='12' y='46' width='138' height='36' rx='9' fill='none' stroke='#ff6fd8' stroke-width='2.5'/><rect x='16' y='92' width='288' height='26' rx='6' fill='#161b22' stroke='#30363d' stroke-width='1'/><text x='26' y='109' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='10' fill='#e6edf3' font-weight='normal' text-anchor='start'>github_pat_11ABC…</text><rect x='256' y='96' width='40' height='18' rx='6' fill='#21262d' stroke='#30363d' stroke-width='1'/><text x='276' y='109' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='10' fill='#e6edf3' font-weight='normal' text-anchor='middle'>Copy</text><rect x='252' y='92' width='48' height='26' rx='9' fill='none' stroke='#ff6fd8' stroke-width='2.5'/></svg>

steps.title: Paste it into myGeeKy
steps.text: Come back here and paste it into the token box.
steps.svg: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150' width='320' height='150'><rect x='0.5' y='0.5' width='319' height='149' rx='10' fill='#0d1117' stroke='#30363d' stroke-width='1'/><text x='16' y='28' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#ff6fd8' font-weight='bold' text-anchor='start'>myGeeKy</text><text x='16' y='50' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#e6edf3' font-weight='normal' text-anchor='start'>Paste it into the token box</text><rect x='16' y='62' width='288' height='28' rx='6' fill='#161b22' stroke='#30363d' stroke-width='1'/><text x='26' y='80' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#e6edf3' font-weight='normal' text-anchor='start'>github_pat_11ABC…</text><rect x='12' y='58' width='296' height='36' rx='9' fill='none' stroke='#ff6fd8' stroke-width='2.5'/><text x='16' y='112' font-family='Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' font-size='10' fill='#8b949e' font-weight='normal' text-anchor='start'>It stays on this device only, in its secure storage</text></svg>
